gtia.crafting_station.empty: Place chests or other containers on the sides or below the station to craft from them.
gtia.machine.ammonia_converter.tooltip.f: Half of the nitrogen in your body passed through a Haber-Bosch reactor
gtia.machine.ammonia_converter.tooltip.m: Nitrogen and Hydrogen (1:3) into 1,000 mB of Ammonia
Gives off 500 mB of Steam per run
gtia.machine.ammonia_converter.tooltip.r: Magnetite catalyst in an Input Bus (not consumed)
Overclocks like a GregTech machine and supports Batch Mode
gtia.machine.bayer_digester.tooltip.fact: Almost all of the world's alumina still comes from this 1888 process
gtia.machine.bayer_digester.tooltip.main: Circuit 1: Bauxite and Sodium Hydroxide in steam become Sodium Aluminate and Red Mud
Circuit 2: Sodium Aluminate precipitates Aluminium Hydroxide and gives the soda back
gtia.machine.bayer_digester.tooltip.requ: Circuit 1 also burns 1,000 mB of Steam per run
Circuit 2 needs one Aluminium Hydroxide as seed (not consumed)
Overclocks like a GregTech machine and supports Batch Mode
gtia.machine.catalytic_dehydrator.toolti: Converts ethanol into ethylene and water.
Steam input halves the processing time.
gtia.machine.contact_converter.tooltip.f: Sulfuric acid is the most produced chemical on Earth
gtia.machine.contact_converter.tooltip.m: Burns Sulfur with Oxygen and Water into 1,000 mB of Sulfuric Acid
Gives off 2,000 mB of Steam per run: send it to a turbine or the Bayer Digester
gtia.machine.contact_converter.tooltip.r: Vanadium Pentoxide catalyst in an Input Bus (not consumed)
Overclocks like a GregTech machine and supports Batch Mode
gtia.machine.diaphragm_cell.tooltip.fact: Chlorine and caustic soda always come out together, in the same ratio
gtia.machine.diaphragm_cell.tooltip.main: Splits 4,000 mB of Salt Water into 2,000 mB Chlorine, 2,000 mB Hydrogen and 4,000 mB Cell Liquor
A Centrifuge turns the Cell Liquor into Sodium Hydroxide and returns half the salt
gtia.machine.diaphragm_cell.tooltip.requ: An Asbestos Diaphragm in an Input Bus: 1% chance to wear out per run
One Centrifuge keeps up with one Cell
Overclocks like a GregTech machine and supports Batch Mode
gtia.machine.fermentation_vat.tooltip.pu: Makes biomass from plants and water, then ferments biomass into ethanol.
gtia.machine.fermentation_vat.tooltip.yi: Accepts several plant sources; higher tiers process the same recipes faster.
gtia.machine.hall_heroult_cell.tooltip.f: Before 1886, aluminium cost more than gold
gtia.machine.hall_heroult_cell.tooltip.m: Reduces 2 Alumina into 4 Aluminium Ingots in molten Cryolite
Vents 3,000 mB of Carbon Dioxide per run
gtia.machine.hall_heroult_cell.tooltip.r: Burns one Carbon Anode per run
Cryolite is the bath: 5% chance to be used up per run
Overclocks like a GregTech machine and supports Batch Mode
gtia.machine.lime_kiln.tooltip.fact.0: Lime kilns are older than writing
gtia.machine.lime_kiln.tooltip.main.1: Also calcines Aluminium Hydroxide into Alumina and Sodium Bicarbonate into Soda Ash
gtia.machine.lime_kiln.tooltip.requireme: One Charcoal, Coal or Coke per batch, in the second slot
Accepts up to 5 Coke Oven Hatches for automation
gtia.machine.solvay_tower.tooltip.fact.0: Ernest Solvay's 1861 process retired the dirty Leblanc soda works
gtia.machine.solvay_tower.tooltip.main.0: Salt Water, Ammonia and Carbon Dioxide into Sodium Bicarbonate and Ammonium Chloride
gtia.machine.solvay_tower.tooltip.main.1: Calcine the bicarbonate into Soda Ash in the Lime Kiln
gtia.machine.solvay_tower.tooltip.requir: Recover the Ammonia from Ammonium Chloride with Quicklime in a Chemical Reactor
Overclocks like a GregTech machine and supports Batch Mode
gtia.machine.still.tooltip.purpose: Separates the wood condensate and its fractions; the circuit picks the cut.
gtia.machine.wood_retort.tooltip.fact.0: Until the 1920s, most of the world's methanol came from cooking wood
gtia.machine.wood_retort.tooltip.main.0: Cooks 4 logs into 3 Charcoal and 1,000 mB of Charcoal Byproducts
gtia.machine.wood_retort.tooltip.main.1: Burns its own wood gas: no fuel, no power
gtia.machine.wood_retort.tooltip.require: Accepts up to 5 Coke Oven Hatches for automation
Three Retorts keep one Still busy on circuit 1
gtia.rule.recipes.duration_multiplier.de: Multiplies the time of every GregTech machine recipe. Lower is faster.
gtia.rule.steam.duration_multiplier_stea: Multiplies the recipe time of the GTNA steam multiblocks, on top of the recipe duration rule.
gtia.rule.steam.parallel_multiplier.desc: Multiplies how many recipes the GTNA steam multiblocks run at once.
gtia.rules.preset.custom.desc: Starts from the selected preset; edit every value below.
gtia.rules.preset.journey.desc: A gentler pace: faster recipes and stronger steam machines.
gtia.rules.screen.button.tooltip: Difficulty preset of this world: Journey, Normal or Custom. It can't be changed after the world is created.
gtia.rules.screen.locked: A world's rules are fixed when it is created.
gtia.rules.screen.title: GTIA Rules
gtia.rules.warning.file_mismatch: gtia_rules.json was edited, but a world's rules can't change. This world stays %s.
gtia.rules.warning.missing: This world had lost its GTIA rules, so it was set to %s. Back up your saves before moving them around.
